notes.title: Crime O'Clock AMA with Game Director, Jacopo Musso on June 22, 7pm CEST.
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Steam Next Fest![/h1]

Jacopo Musso, Game Director on Crime O'Clock will be live on Thursday 22, June at 7pm CEST/8AM PT to answer a couple of question and play the game! We will answer a couple of questions about game development, challenges and some fun insights from the dev team!

You can also discover by yourself the demo during the Steam Next Fest!

The demo features:
[b]Case File #000 - The Apartment in Pink -[/b] Missing jewels in a fashion victim apartment… A classic case? Find the thief and recover the stolen goods! - This is the introduction/tutorial of the game.
[b]Case File #002 - The Red Blood Stained Band -[/b] Legendary singer Axl Blood has been the victim of an unexpected accident. What if it was intentional in the end? - This is the very first "real" crime case that comes from the Information Age.
[b]Case File #004 - The Brown Billygoat -[/b] What is doing this silly goat? - This case is bringing you to the Lost Age, a brand new map that will be playable for the very first time!

This time, the demo is available in all languages that are also available in the game so : [b]english, italian, german, spanish, brazilian portuguese and french![/b]


We sincerely hope to meet you on Thursday and we cannot wait to hear your thoughts about the demo!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Starting, and we have many news!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

We know we've been quiet for some time, but we were busy polishing every possible aspect before the launch. We can't wait to find out what you think of the game!

Since the Nintendo Indie World, a lot of things happens and it's now time for many announcements around Crime O'Clock!

[h1]Steam new release date[/h1]
First of all, the release date on PC has moved. We are sorry to have to delay the game's release on Steam by a few days. The new release date is now planned for July 21st.

We are trying to finalize all platform-specific features (achievements, cloud saves, etc.), and getting things done right takes time.
We've worked hard these past few months and want everything to be at its best when you get your hands on the game. For this reason, we are forced to postpone the game's release.

We are sure you will understand and agree with us, also because we are following the master's teachings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42846609/4ea9ae37c4b96995f9b7750de1f8ce4d8753808a.jpg[/img]


In the meantime, our launch trailer is almost ready and we'll be able to share it with you very soon now...[i] Speaking of new content, should we start right away?[/i]

[h1]Introducing Fulcrum Stories![/h1]
Highly requested, we've worked a lot to bring the "Fulcrum Stories" alive! 
In this game mode, totally aside from the 40+ main criminal cases, you'll be able to freely move between time ticks on a map and look for several characters that you might recognize... Try to uncover their own unique stories!

You'll have more than 30 Fulcrum stories to follow!
[i]You might even find some cool pop-culture references... [/i]

[h1]Steam Next Fest[/h1]
We're part of the Steam Next Fest with a new demo and new cases to solve! You'll be able to play by yourself the Lost Age!

The demo features:
[b]Case File #000 - The Apartment in Pink -[/b] Missing jewels in a fashion victim apartment… A classic case? Find the thief and recover the stolen goods! - This is the introduction/tutorial of the game.
[b]Case File #002 - The Red Blood Stained Band -[/b] Legendary singer Axl Blood has been the victim of an unexpected accident. What if it was intentional in the end? - This is the very first "real" crime case that comes from the Information Age.
[b]Case File #004 - The Brown Billygoat -[/b] What is doing this silly goat? - This case is bringing you to the Lost Age, a brand new map that will be playable for the very first time!

This time, the demo is available in all languages that are also available in the game so : [b]english, italian, german, spanish, brazilian portuguese and french![/b]

[h2]What about other languages?[/h2]
Crime O'Clock is a crime investigation game, which means that there is a lot of text and investigation to adapt. Non-latin alphabets are always more complicated for european teams to adapt... but the good news is that we have found local partners to help us in this beautiful journey! We're currently working to bring Crime O'Clock in simplified chinese and japanese! We can't wait to share with you these versions. 
Stay tuned for more news about these languages and even more!

[h2]Any questions?[/h2]
Catch us during the Steam Next Fest! Jacopo Musso, Game Director on Crime O'Clock will be live on Thursday 22, June at 7pm CEST/9AM PT to answer a couple of question and play the game!

Thank you very much for all your support since the very first announcement to those who just joined us! 
We cannot wait to welcome you on Crime O'Clock in just a month!

Bad Seed & Just For Games Teams!

notes.title: Solve crimes as a time-travelling detective in this Where's Wally-like puzzler
notes.notes:
Freshly announced puzzle game Crime O’Clock will be putting you in the shoes of a time-travelling detective when it comes out on June 30th, its release date seemingly perfectly timed (sorry) to coincide with Capcom's object-hopping time puzzle detective game, Ghost Trick. In all seriousness, though, Crime O'Clock looks to be its own distinctive beast (and not just because you seem to play as a rabbit). It has shades of Where’s Wally? (or Waldo, Wanda, Willy, Valli, and my favourite, Ali for international readers) as you’re given densely illustrated maps to navigate, and pick out key details in order to stitch together clues to solve cases. It could be very cool if all the right cogs click together.

Read more

notes.title: Crime O'Clock - DEMO Live during Mystery Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42846609/64b754670f18bade8fc36b18dd81ee8080606c14.png[/img]

We’re proud to announce that “Crime O’Clock” is part of Steam’s MysteryFest!

For the duration of the event, you can download and play a demo, and experience the main features of the game.

Looking for an intriguing game that twists space and time and takes you to many different ages to prevent something more than crimes and thefts? Search no more, and let us know your first impressions on the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736290/

[h3]What can I expect from the demo?[/h3]
You'll be able to discover our two introductory investigations to sharpen your detective sense, and the very first case from the True Timeline!

[list]
[*] [b]Case File #000 - The Apartment in Pink - [/b]Missing jewels in a fashion victim apartment… A classic case? Find the thief and recover the stolen goods!
[*] [b]Case File #001 - The Enigmatic Lime Drink -[/b] A crime case featuring the writer & archeologist professor Daniele Marrone? Please, Sit & Sip...
[*] [b]Case File #002 - The Red Blood Stained Band -[/b] Legendary singer Axl Blood has been the victim of an unexpected accident. What if it was intentional in the end?
[/list]

[h2]The Information Age[/h2]
The Information Age map is based on the city of Milan (Italy), our hometown!
It features Duomo di Milano, Castello Sforzesco, The Last Supper and more… We're super proud of the result and we have made a little GIF for you that compares in-real Milano vs In-game Milano! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42846609/68b54b14b1e91fa7da6c3479cc2c2f68499addd0.gif[/img]

Last point for you: the demo is only available in english for now, but the game will be fully available in english, italian, french, german, spanish, brazilian portugueuse, simplified chinese and japanese! 

Thank you again for all your support! It means so much!

Bad Seed team
